IC 2TITLE 2. GENERAL ASSEMBLY
IC 2-5ARTICLE 5. LEGISLATIVE SERVICES
IC 2-5-36Chapter 36. Example Commission
IC 2-5-36-1Definitions

Sec. 1. As used in this chapter, "commission" means the example commission.

As added by P.L.1-1990, SEC.2. Amended by P.L.10-2024, SEC.3.

IC 2-5-36-9Duties of the commission

Note: This version of section effective until 7-1-2027. See also following version of this section, effective 7-1-2027.

Sec. 9. The commission shall meet quarterly.

As amended by P.L.20-2025, SEC.4.

IC 2-5-36-9Duties of the commission

Note: This version of section effective 7-1-2027. See also preceding version of this section, effective until 7-1-2027.

Sec. 9. The commission shall meet monthly.

As amended by P.L.20-2025, SEC.4. Amended by P.L.30-2026, SEC.1.
